resources.string: Ease into the evening with a warm filter that follows you across your phone.
Your screen is using its original colors.
A warm tint is active across supported screens.
From a gentle golden tint to a deeper amber.
Choose how much of the warm tint covers your screen.
Allow Amber to display over other apps so the filter can follow you when you leave this app.

Android may hide filters on protected apps, permission dialogs, the lock screen, and parts of the system interface. If a button will not respond, turn the filter off from its notification or Quick Settings.\n\nAmber adds a warm tint; it does not change your display hardware or guarantee a medical benefit.
For an easy shortcut, add Amber to your Quick Settings tiles using the panel’s Edit button.
Tap to adjust your warm screen filter.

Open Android Settings → Apps → Special app access → Display over other apps, then allow Amber.
